# Urban Signal

> Urban Signal is an open-source spatial-intelligence system that turns municipal permits, 311 requests, licenses, deeds, executed evictions, and related records into explainable H3-based signals.

## Canonical resources

- [Machine-readable product facts](/facts.json): metros, feed availability, limitations, horizons, and repository evidence paths.
- [Full agent context](/llms-full.txt): product purpose, page guide, processing path, per-city brief schema, and limitations.
- [System overview](/system/): how Socrata, ArcGIS, Carto, CKAN, and static-CSV feeds are ingested, normalized onto an H3 grid, and served as momentum signals.
- [Evidence trace](/evidence/): one permit-shaped record followed through five inspectable contracts, from city registry to versioned edge snapshot.
- [Methodology](/methodology/): Leading Indicator Momentum Score composition across 6-, 12-, and 18-month horizons, including which values on the site are illustrative.
- [Architecture](/architecture/): source producers, city registry, Kafka consumers, H3 enrichment, feature aggregation, catalyst alert dispatch, PostGIS storage, ONNX horizons, edge snapshots.
- [Cities index](/cities/): registered metros with per-feed platform, cadence, and source-contract links.
- [Per-city machine briefs](/public/cities/austin.json): JSON at `/public/cities/<id>.json` for all 101 metros (ids listed on [/cities/](/cities/)); generated from the city registry.
- [Live dashboard](/dashboard): interactive spatial product surface.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/harlanljones/urban-signal): implementation and documentation.
- [City registry](https://github.com/harlanljones/urban-signal/blob/main/apps/api/src/spatial/city_registry.py): authoritative registered-city and feed contracts.

## Important limitations

- Feed coverage varies by metro; never infer uniform four-feed coverage.
- Hero cell values and the 68/100 score composition are illustrative UI examples, not live model-performance claims.
- No customer, adoption, or independently validated performance claims are published.

## Agent discovery

- [API catalog](/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset describing this site's documents and the edge data API (`application/linkset+json`).
- [OpenAPI spec](/.well-known/openapi.json): machine contract for `/facts.json`, `/public/cities/<id>.json`, and the text guides.
- [MCP server card](/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Streamable HTTP MCP server at `/mcp` with read-only tools (`list_cities`, `get_product_facts`, `get_city_brief`, `get_site_guide`).
- [Skills index](/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): sha256-digested SKILL.md artifacts for product facts and methodology.
- [Capability manifest](/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): ARD entries for every machine resource on this host.
- [Protected resource metadata](/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource) and [/auth.md](/auth.md): everything here is public and unauthenticated; no registration step exists.
- Markdown rendering: request any page with `Accept: text/markdown` (each HTML response advertises its twin via `Link; rel="alternate"`); responses carry `x-markdown-tokens`.
- Status: [/healthz](/healthz).
